parsed.stack: iOS + Android (Flutter). Entirely on-device: motion/GPS for the drive, on-device ASR and summarisation for the post-drive note, $0 marginal cost. No backend beyond a tiny countersign relay (Cloudflare Worker + D1) so the parent's tap can happen on their own phone. One-time purchase £4.99/$6.49 (price_month is that amortised over 12 months).
milestones: Week 1-2: automatic drive detection and the 20-minute session record (route, duration, conditions) with no manual entry.
Week 3: on-device post-drive summary and manoeuvre tagging from a 30-second spoken note.
Week 4: one-tap parental countersign from the parent's own device, with a link that does not need the parent to install anything.
Week 5: the unbroken-run view and the exportable log the learner shows their instructor.
Week 6: paid unlock, launch into UK learner-driver communities and two driving schools.
parsed.riskiest_technical_assumption: That on-device drive detection and ASR in a noisy learner's car produce a log that is both accurate and hard to fake - a countersign that is one tap from the learner's own phone is trivially forged, and a log nobody trusts has no reason to exist.
parsed.cheapest_way_to_test_that_assumption: Run a background motion/GPS logger plus on-device ASR on ten real practice drives with three learner-parent pairs and check whether the parent would sign what it produced - two weekends, no purchase.
